title: Phone · Filter listings in a sheet

steps.label: Search results. Open Filters to narrow the list.
The filter sheet opens over the results.
Select a price range. The sheet stays open with the selection checked.
Tap Show results to close the sheet and view the filtered list.

title: Phone · Go from the mobile menu to the sign-in form

steps.label: Tap Open menu to reveal navigation and account links.
Tap Log in from the menu to open the sign-in form.

title: Phone · Switch between a conversation and the inbox

steps.label: Open Messages. The active conversation occupies the phone screen.
Tap Back to conversations to reveal the inbox list.
Tap a conversation to reopen its thread.

title: Phone · Inspect a room and reach the reservation controls

steps.label: Open the accommodation listing and scroll to the room options.
Open More details to inspect the room.
Close the room detail and return to the room options.
Tap Reserve and reach the date and guest controls further down the phone page.

title: Tablet · Filter listings in a sheet

steps.label: Search results. Open Filters to narrow the list.
The filter sheet opens over the results.
Select a price range. The sheet stays open with the selection checked.
Tap Show results to close the sheet and view the filtered list.
